1. **Data Collection**: If your feedback is coming from forms or emails, you can set up a Google Form to collect this data, which feeds directly into a Google Sheet. Alternatively, check if your marketing tools (like HubSpot or SurveyMonkey) offer integration options for pulling in feedback.

2. **Data Automation**: Use Google Apps Script or a similar automation tool to set up a function that summarizes the feedback weekly. You can configure it to run every week on a specific day and compile the data into a single report.

3. **Report Generation**: Create a summary template within your chosen tool that can display the feedback snapshot each week. Make sure it’s user-friendly so you can click a button to generate the report easily.

4. **Alert Setup**: Consider adding email alerts when the report is generated so you and your team stay updated.

You or your team should take over from here to finalize these steps. It’s important to verify the setup against your existing data processes and ensure it meets your needs. A colleague could also review the configuration to confirm everything aligns with your reporting requirements before you start using it regularly.
